title: Staging inert broker probe with no MariaDB service or network impact

phases.objective: Prove the inert Staging probe has no network or existing service changes, including no runtime-db recreation or SQL.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Compare standard Compose config to opt-in profile and inspect live Staging topology without starting containers.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Candidate remains unactivated, without network or DBA authority, while runtime-db config and live identity are intact.
steps: Resolve the standard Compose and opt-in Compose in read-only mode.
Require exact equality of every existing application/DB/Redis service and declared network.
Require candidate network_mode none, non-root read-only and no dependencies, env secrets, exposed ports or volumes.
Cross-check live runtime-db health, original network, no exposed port, and app exact SHA without mutation.
Reject stale SHA, missing candidate, network or service changes and any candidate already present.
assertions: Neither source/test nor read-only preflight may create networks, start/recreate services, connect to DB or mutate Production.
GitHub owner code attestation cannot be interpreted as a cryptographically signed DBA operation.
Even a passing probe is never a certified operational broker or backup/restore acceptance.
Shared Local Connector and deployment semantics reviewed for both environments; Production mutation remains false.
